title: Learning Perturbation-Specific Representations through Conditional Energy Prior for Cellular Response Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.18456v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI-based cellular perturbation prediction is essential to accelerate drug discovery and therapeutic identification. However, perturbation-specific signals are generally obscured by cellular complexity, making it difficult for existing methods to correctly capture perturbation effects. To address this problem, we propose PerturbEnergy, which introduces a conditional energy-based prior over perturbation representations. It assigns lower energy (higher probability) to representations compatible with the given perturbation and higher energy to others, thereby explicitly tilting the latent space toward perturbation-preferred regions. Besides, PerturbEnergy can be integrated into autoencoder architectures as we find its Evidence Lower Bound (ELBO) is equivalent to the ELBO of the complete autoencoder. We further prove that optimizing PerturbEnergy increases the lower bound on the conditional mutual information between representation and pert

translated_title: 通过条件能量先验学习扰动特异性表征以预测细胞响应
translated_abstract: 基于AI的细胞扰动预测对于加速药物发现和治疗方法鉴定至关重要。然而，扰动特异性信号通常被细胞的复杂性所掩盖，使得现有方法难以正确捕获扰动效应。为解决这一问题，我们提出了PerturbEnergy，该方法在扰动表征上引入了基于条件的能量先验。它为与给定扰动兼容的表征分配较低的能量（即较高的概率），而为其他表征分配较高的能量，从而显式地将潜在空间倾斜向扰动偏好区域。此外，PerturbEnergy可以集成到自编码器架构中，因为我们发现其证据下界（ELBO）与完整自编码器的证据下界等价。我们进一步证明，优化PerturbEnergy能够提升表征与扰动之间条件互信息的下界……
tldr: 提出PerturbEnergy方法，通过在扰动表征上引入条件能量先验，显式地将潜在空间偏向扰动偏好区域，从而提升细胞扰动响应预测的准确性。
en_tdlr: PerturbEnergy introduces a conditional energy-based prior over perturbation representations, explicitly tilting the latent space toward perturbation-preferred regions to improve cellular response prediction.
